body.name: Prefix-extremizer rank-state synthesis handle
body.construction: Partition a valid row by which prefix and suffix argmin sets attain each of the five legal Cartesian-product slack minima at every middle level; augment this label by the rank increments of the tight response-type rows; quotient labels that induce the same renormalized deletion and successor actions; then synthesize the finite transition labels and triangular register coordinates from these geometric actions, with the staircase family in \(\text{def:staircase-family}\) as a mandatory stress-test sublanguage.
